title: Who should a terminal pane input lock block?
recommendation: Block user and agent input; separate interrupt/terminate controls keep existing behavior.
presentation: Answered by Jared; do not re-ask.
resolution: Both user typing/paste and agent terminal input are blocked, with explicit blocked result for agents; output and independent interrupt/terminate behavior continue.

title: How long should a terminal pane input lock remain set?
recommendation: Keep for the exact live session, including reconnect; replacement starts unlocked.
presentation: Plain-language question answered explicitly by Jared: Keep for the same session; canonical DL-037 records the disposition.
disposition: Retain lock for the exact verified live session including reconnect/PM reopen; replacement starts unlocked.
